main.description: Asks the AppView to verify one repo the client copied to its PDS. The AppView syncs the repo from the PDS and compares it with its own copy. On a match the PDS becomes the source of truth. On a mismatch the repo stays hosted by the AppView, and the client may try again.

mode.description: Where the user's repos live after this call.

missing.description: Records the AppView holds that the PDS copy lacks or differs on, when verification fails.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The arguments are inconsistent or malformed beyond schema validation.

errors.name: SpaceNotFound
errors.description: No space matches the given space reference.

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: The caller may not write to or read from this repo in the space.

errors.name: RepoNotHosted
errors.description: The AppView does not host the caller's repo in this space, because it lives on the caller's PDS. Write to the PDS instead.

errors.name: MigrationNotStarted
errors.description: The repo is not in the migrating state.

errors.name: VerificationFailed
errors.description: The PDS copy could not be read or did not match.
